title: Extra Payment-Plan Installments for Families with Free or Reduced-Price Meal Status
content:
**Rule.** Under Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, a family whose Pre-K child's School Nutrition Services Meal Account in status active holds a free or reduced-price meal status has the child's Pre-K tuition payment plan spread over more installments:

| Tier on the child's active meal account | Additional installments |
|---|---|
| any Free Meal Status tier: Free Meal Status (Prior-Year Carryover), Free Meal Status (Household Application), Free Meal Status (Direct Certification) or Free Meal Status (Categorical Eligibility) | 2 more |
| any Reduced-Price Meal Status tier: Reduced-Price Meal Status (Prior-Year Carryover) or Reduced-Price Meal Status | 1 more |
| Paid Meal Status, or no active meal account | none |

The meal account read is the Pre-K child's own; the meal status of a brother or sister does not count.

## Examples (hypothetical families)

- Child's active account holds Free Meal Status (Direct Certification): 2 more installments.
- Child's active account holds Reduced-Price Meal Status (Prior-Year Carryover): 1 more installment.
- Child's active account holds Paid Meal Status: no additional installment.
